payout_quote: You will receive a payment of $30 for each study in which you participate and provide a blood sample. You will receive an additional $15 for the very first blood draw as a member of the UAB HDC. Payment will be made via Greenphire ClinCard at the time of blood donation.
steps: Open the UAB Immunology Institute 'Healthy Donor Cohort' page

Confirm you meet the healthy-adult criteria (18+, 110+ lbs, no active cancer in past 5 years, no autoimmune/anemia/lymphopenia diagnoses, no immune modulating drugs, no chronic viral infection treatment, non-pregnant)
Complete the enrollment questionnaire at the redcap.link/uabhdc link and provide consent to be contacted
Wait for encrypted text/email invitations to UAB studies needing blood samples
Schedule and attend a blood donation visit for a study you choose to join — $30 per study (+$15 extra on your very first draw), paid via Greenphire ClinCard at the time of donation
catches: Must pass health screening: no active cancer within 5 years, no autoimmune disorders, no anemia/lymphopenia, no immune modulating drugs, no chronic viral infection treatment, 110+ lbs, non-pregnant
Pay is per blood-draw visit ($30; first draw $45 with bonus) — invitations are periodic, not guaranteed or on a fixed schedule
Involves blood donation — physical procedure, must provide informed consent
Study topics are unknown in advance; participation in each future study is voluntary but required to earn
biggest_catch: Pay is per blood-draw study ($30, first draw $45) and study invitations are periodic — there is no guaranteed schedule or income level, and you must pass a health screen.
eligibility: Healthy non-pregnant adult 18+ weighing at least 110 lbs; no active cancer in past 5 years; no autoimmune disorders, anemia, or lymphopenia; not treated with immune modulating drugs or for chronic viral infection(s).
timing: Enrollment questionnaire ~15 min; each blood donation visit ~30-60 min active. Paid via Greenphire ClinCard at the time of blood donation.
